expected_symptom: IDxcContainerReflection enumerates parts of a linked (cs_6_3) container and never finds DXC_PART_REFLECTION_DATA (RDAT); reporter asserts foundRDAT is true and it fails.
godbolt_skip: container-part absence after IDxcLinker::Link; CE runs one dxc invocation per pane and exposes no linker (dxl) equivalent, so the symptom (a linked, non-library container's part table) cannot be produced there
reviewed_by: gpt-5.3-codex (independent batch-019 step-10 review; applied selectively at collation)
summary: RDAT is written only for library-profile containers (DxilContainerAssembler.cpp, keyed on ShaderModel::IsLib()); any finalized non-library container -- whether reached via IDxcLinker::Link(...,cs_6_3,...) or by direct compilation to cs_6_3 -- gets PSV0 instead and never RDAT. Confirmed on current main (89e2f98e2) and unchanged from the reporter's own v1.7.2308 build. ID3D12ShaderReflection (via dxa -dumpreflection) fully resolves both bound resources on the linked container, so no reflection data is actually lost -- RDAT specifically feeds the library-only ID3D12LibraryReflection interface, which does not apply post-link. Working as designed, not a bug; docs could state this explicitly.
title: RDAT part is missing when linking a compute shader
